# What we need from you: Fernhill Florists

Please send these by 4 November 2026. Anything you cannot send, tell us and we will work around it.

## Send us
1. (C-1) How many wedding orders come in during your busiest month, roughly.
2. (C-2) A photo of one week of the wedding diary.

## Access we ask for (read-only)
1. (C-3) The online shop: a read-only staff view, or an export of last month's orders. Read-only, please; we will ask you to remove it when the plan is delivered.

## Workshops
1. Tuesday 3 November 2026, one hour: how a wedding order travels from the phone to the van. Who should come: the shop owner and the van driver.
